fail=1; }\n[ \"$(BOOKINGS=$t bash src/list.sh 2026-01-02)\" = '2026-01-02 10:00-11:00 aoi x' ] || { echo \"list by date\"; fail=1; }\nrm -f \"$t\"; exit $fail\n---\ncat: spec/list_date.spec.sh: No such file or directory\n---\n    feat(list): 部屋で一覧を絞り込む --room (#88)\n\n spec/list_room.spec.sh | 6 ++++++\n src/list.sh            | 4 +++-\n 2 files changed, 9 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)\n\n    docs(list): 先頭のコメントに --room を書く (#88)\n\n src/list.sh | 2 +-\n 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)\n---\ncheck\nlint\npurge-archive\nrelease\n#!/bin/bash\n# lint: every script parses (bash -n), no line ends with whitespace, and src/*.sh declare set -u.
